landing.headline: Training that adapts to you
landing.body: Answer a few questions and get a workout for every day — built around your goals, your schedule, your equipment and how your last session actually went.

disclaimer.short: General training guidance, not medical advice.
disclaimer.long: Plates & Pace gives general training and nutrition guidance. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Talk to a doctor before starting hard training, especially if you have a health condition or any symptoms.

notes.estimateOnly: These are estimates to start from, not medical advice. Adjust them to how you feel and how your training goes.
notes.noDeficitUnder18: You are under 18, so this plan does not use a calorie deficit.
notes.conservativeMode: Your health answers put you in a careful start, so this plan does not use a calorie deficit.
notes.calorieFloorApplied: This has been raised to a safe minimum rather than going lower.
